_doc: The machine-readable Phase-3 row-set — the SINGLE source that drives scripts/golden-bootstrap.cjs and against which the CLAUDE.md Phase-3 tables + the rendered tree are validated three ways. Every row mirrors a parsed CLAUDE.md table cell EXACTLY (node scripts/golden-bootstrap.cjs --dump-tables). The three red-gate scripts, the red-gate hook row, and the LICENSE row all resolve like any other row: the three scripts ship in templates/scripts/, and the red-gate hook + LICENSE rows are in the CLAUDE.md always-generated table, so the --diff is ENFORCING (known-gaps.json emptied). render: 'wiring' = fill {{placeholders}} + scan (deterministic files the bootstrap MUST fill — incl. LICENSE, filled from the owner's holder/year/type); 'copy' = ship the template verbatim (forms keep their placeholders, not scanned); 'empty' = generated empty. tiers/locus/deliverable/app_map/risk_armed encode the conditional rows so Lite/Full/non-hybrid renders do not false-diff (M26.D: two tiers — lite and full, the merged default; risk_armed rows generate only when a risk trigger is declared, per calibration-core.json risk_armed_modules, and are excluded from the unarmed reference renders). ENUMERATION MODEL: this row-set is ALSO the golden catalog validate-validator-enumeration.cjs reconciles the shipped hooks/scripts/commands against (each is a 1:1 render row here). REFERENCED⇒PRESENT (M27.D, KF-48 instance 1 — this note previously said the opposite). Until M27.D only the HEADLINE validator rows rendered (validate-stage-prompts/retrospective/app-map/test-honesty + README) and this note declared that adding the rest 'would change the rendered scaffold COUNT and is deliberately NOT done'. The md2page trial priced that decision: a generated project's own .githooks/pre-commit NAMED TWELVE validators while its scaffold carried FOUR, and the hook's [ -f ] guards made all eight gaps SILENT passes. Every validator referenced by any GENERATED artifact now carries a row here at the tier that claims it; node scripts/golden-bootstrap.cjs --generated-refs enforces it, DERIVED from the generated layer's own references so a new referencing artifact fails without anyone editing a list. The count grew with it (full ~108 / lite ~44) — that growth IS the fix. The two kit-only validators (validate-entry-docs, validate-validator-enumeration) are excused by the honest 'kit-only, not copied into projects' label on their own reference lines, read AT THE REFERENCE SITE, never hand-declared in a baseline; validate-sources stays baselined pending the research_publish artifact set (see registry-known-gaps.json). Per-class catalog scope is unchanged: validators -> validators/README.md + the two scaffold-table docs; hooks/scripts/commands -> CLAUDE.md scaffold tables + this row-set.

It ships from scripts/lib/ rather than validators/lib/ because --adopt installs scripts/ but not validators/, and a module-less hook is a DORMANT control in every adopted repo (byte-parity with the kit's scripts/lib/stage-structure.cjs).

KF-01 (M26.A) — the sole BLOCKS-ANY-RELEASE finding. The G14 seeded-defect set had a template tree, a shipped validator (validate-calibration.cjs, project-relative --set default) and a MANDATORY Stage-V self-test, but no generation row: every bootstrapped Standard+ project fail-closed exit 2 on its first /verify. Copied byte-for-byte from the kit (render:copy) — the fixtures are seeded DEFECTS and their labels are the sealed answers; neither is ever filled or authored.

KF-23 (M26.A) — KF-01 exactly twice over: templates/release-state.md existed, G15 (validate-transition) and G16 (validate-release-readiness) both police it and both ship wired into the generated pre-commit hook fail-closed, and gates.md carries both rows — with no generation row the six-state release ladder was SILENT, not satisfied (a file that never exists is never staged, so the validators were never invoked).

KF-41 (M26.A) — the kit shipped READMEs for SUBDIRECTORIES (build-prompts, retrospectives, validators) and none for the front door, while PROJECT-CLAUDE.md §13 (AI-assistance disclosure) and §8 (byline decision) both assign README.md load-bearing jobs. v0.1.0 released through a passing G16 whole-product review with no front door. render:copy — the README is a FORM authored during bootstrap from identity/scope, not a deterministic wiring file, so its {{placeholders}} ship intact and are not placeholder-scanned (the honest locus).
